prose_updates.tldr: Recorded propensities identify the causal effect matrix and make the entrywise IPW errors a bounded row-major martingale difference array.  On the frozen predictable class the strongest common-risk statement is the honest bracket \(c b_{nm}\le\inf_{\widetilde U}\sup_P E_P[\mathcal L(\widetilde U,U)]\le\sup_P E_P[\mathcal L(\widehat U^{\mathrm I},U)]\le C a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\).  Thus \(b_{nm}\) is a minimax lower/reference scale, not a matched frontier.  The endogenous-target construction rules out uniform \(b_{nm}\)-attainment by recorded IPW--SVD only; whether another observed-data estimator closes the bracket remains open.  Blind row scaling is certified only at the explicit \(d_{nm}\) resolution: both its causal loss and its observed disagreement differ from total drift by \(O_P(d_{nm})\).  With fixed \(r,\mu,K,q\), bounded aspect ratio, and \(b_{nm}=o(1)\), one has \(d_{nm}/b_{nm}\asymp\sqrt n\), so no \(b_{nm}\)-scale iff is claimed.  The rank-one \(0.25/0.75\) Markov law remains an explicit failure witness for blind scaling and a HeartSteps II stress design.  For predeclared dense families, direct finite-sample bands have a separate \(\sqrt{\log|\mathcal G_n|}\) multiplicity cost and make no feasible-multiplier exactness claim.

project_justification.gap: Published independent-mask rowwise matrix results do not settle causal effect-subspace risk under history-predictable assignment.  On the present effect-only low-rank class, a constant-propensity packing yields the lower/reference scale \(b_{nm}\), while a matrix-Freedman and deterministic subspace argument yields only \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\) for recorded IPW--SVD.  The accepted endogenous-target example prevents labeling the latter estimator as \(b_{nm}\)-optimal, but it does not prove an estimator-independent lower bound above \(b_{nm}\).
project_justification.niche: The contribution is an explicit same-loss minimax bracket for a causal row subspace under predictable masks, together with an estimator-specific obstruction, a calibrated blind-normalization resolution theorem, and conservative simultaneous causal-contrast bands whose entropy cost is kept separate from the subspace scales.
project_justification.fill: The project proves an expected normalized maximum-row upper bound for recorded IPW--SVD, combines it with the constant-propensity minimax lower bound in one risk criterion, and records the remaining rate gap.  It proves two unconditional \(d_{nm}\)-resolution inequalities for blind scaling and shows algebraically that the former \(d_{nm}=O(b_{nm})\) premise is unavailable in the fixed-complexity \(b_{nm}=o(1)\) regime.  It also supplies the explicit Markov witness and a direct finite-sample union-bound band with separate family-size inflation.

prose_updates.honest_scope: Identification is given by the recorded IPW conditional mean.  The proved statistical statement is the expected-risk bracket between the lower/reference scale \(b_{nm}\) and the loose IPW--SVD radius \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\); these rates are not claimed to match.  The adaptive endogenous-target construction refutes only uniform \(b_{nm}\)-attainment by the specified IPW--SVD estimator.  It does not show that every estimator measurable from \(A,Y,p\) fails at that scale, so minimax tightness and the sharp constant remain open.  The blind procedure is introduced here and is certified only up to \(d_{nm}\); no unconditional \(b_{nm}\)-scale validity criterion or feasible tangent correction is claimed.  The \(0.25/0.75\) Markov sequence is a boundary example for that procedure, not a refutation of a published method.  Simultaneous inference is supplied by conservative finite-sample direct-IPW radii, not by asymptotic exactness of the frozen leave-one-cell-out multiplier statistic.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: Operator-norm martingale concentration followed by a deterministic subspace inequality pays the factor \(\sqrt{n/(\mu r)}\), producing \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\).  The frozen class permits the target singular factors to depend on earlier outcomes, so the usual leave-one-row argument cannot simply treat those factors as predictable; the explicit obstruction shows that this is substantive for IPW--SVD.  The minimax lower scale \(b_{nm}\) therefore remains separated from the available upper rate.  For blind normalization, the ratio residual and stochastic spectral perturbation give resolution \(d_{nm}\); at fixed complexity and bounded aspect ratio, \(d_{nm}/b_{nm}\asymp\sqrt n\) whenever \(b_{nm}=o(1)\).  The separate arm means in the denominator derivative are not estimable at a claimed frontier rate under the current effect-only low-rank assumptions.  No residual covariance consistency, positive random studentizer, or feasible multiplier exactness is assumed or claimed.

sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: Recorded IPW--SVD uses the known predictable propensities and requires no estimated treatment nuisance.  Its expected-risk guarantee follows from bounded matrix-martingale concentration and a deterministic singular-subspace bound.  The blind procedure replaces entrywise propensities by a clipped empirical row fraction; propensity-path stability and the primitive oracle gap control its tangent expansion only at the explicit \(d_{nm}\) resolution.  The observed discrepancy compares blind and recorded fits at that same resolution and is not advertised as a \(b_{nm}\)-scale certificate.  Simultaneous bands use the direct recorded-IPW contrast and deterministic variance envelopes; leave-one-cell-out residuals and multiplier studentization are not needed for the conservative coverage theorem.

prose_updates.related_work:
Mehrotra, Tran, Vu, and Zampetakis are the closest rowwise estimator comparator: their public Algorithm 1, Theorem 3.2, and Corollary 3.3 analyze separate empirical-row-scaled SVD fits for two low-rank arm means under independent Bernoulli assignment.  Their geometric rowwise matrix-error scale motivates \(b^0_{nm}\), but their theorem does not cover history-predictable masks, effect-only low rank, the effect matrix's left singular space, or the present minimax criterion.  Cai, Li, Chi, Poor, and Chen prove two-to-infinity upper and lower bounds for an independently sampled low-rank matrix with independent noise; those results inform the deterministic perturbation and local packing architecture but do not make the causal target predictable under the row-major filtration.  The present result is therefore an honest bracket rather than a claimed matched extension of either paper.

Hadad, Hirshberg, Zhan, Wager, and Athey support the recorded-propensity martingale-score reduction, and Tropp supplies the bounded-increment matrix Freedman inequality used for the upper moment bound.  Dwivedi, Tian, Tomkins, Klasnja, Murphy, and Shah study adaptive nearest-neighbor estimation of unit-by-time arm means under an exogenous factor model, a different target and structural class.  Athey, Bayati, Doudchenko, Imbens, and Khosravi; Sun, Zhu, and Dubin; Bai and Ng; Agarwal, Dahleh, Shah, and Shen; Choi and Yuan; Mao, Wong, and Chen; and Wang, Wong, Mao, and Chan address outcome completion, treatment effects on treated cells, entrywise or Frobenius loss, or fixed missingness structures.  None supplies the missing estimator-independent upper rate for the present predictable effect-subspace class, and the current effect-only rank condition does not imply their outcome-matrix assumptions.

Khan and Ugander analyze scalar affine normalization under independent indicators; the blind row-fraction SVD and its \(0.25/0.75\) Markov witness are new objects here and do not refute that published procedure.  Belloni and Oliveira and Ma, Niu, Zhang, and Zhu motivate high-dimensional martingale or multiplier inference, but the retained simultaneous theorem uses direct finite-sample Freedman radii and a union bound only.  Its \(\sqrt{\log|\mathcal G_n|}\) factor is a query-family entropy cost, not part of either subspace scale.  Spruijt-Metz et al. make saved propensities and omission sensitivity operationally relevant for the HeartSteps II consumer.

statement_notes.justification: This is the explicit achievable side for the specified recorded-propensity IPW--SVD estimator; the companion moment proposition places it in the expected-loss criterion used by the converse.
statement_notes.gap: The rate is \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\), not the lower/reference scale \(b_{nm}\).  The endogenous-target witness rules out replacing it by \(b_{nm}\) for this estimator but says nothing conclusive about all observed-data estimators.
statement_notes.consumer: Designers obtain a conservative, fully explicit row-subspace error radius under recorded predictable randomization.

statement_notes.justification: This proposition is the headline same-risk synthesis: the converse and achievability sides are both stated in expected normalized maximum-row loss.
statement_notes.gap: The endpoints \(b_{nm}\) and \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\) need not coincide; closing this minimax gap is the residual question.
statement_notes.consumer: Trial designers can separate an information-theoretic lower benchmark from the guarantee of the concrete IPW--SVD fit.

statement_notes.justification: The constant-propensity packing establishes \(b_{nm}\) as a legal minimax lower/reference scale inside the frozen predictable class.
statement_notes.gap: It does not match the available \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\) upper bound and does not show that the IPW obstruction raises the minimax risk for every estimator.
statement_notes.consumer: The result supplies the lower endpoint of the common expected-risk bracket.

statement_notes.justification: The retained theorem calibrates the causal blind-fit error and the observable blind-versus-recorded discrepancy against total drift at the actually proved stochastic resolution.
statement_notes.gap: The resolution is \(d_{nm}\).  With fixed complexity and \(b_{nm}=o(1)\), \(d_{nm}/b_{nm}\asymp\sqrt n\), so the previous conditional \(b_{nm}\)-scale iff is not advertised.
statement_notes.consumer: HeartSteps-style analyses may use the discrepancy as a coarse warning statistic, with its \(d_{nm}\) resolution stated explicitly.

statement_notes.justification: The exact rank-one calculation is the early kill test and a concrete boundary example for the newly defined blind procedure.
statement_notes.gap: It shows blind failure and diagnostic separation on one \(0.25/0.75\) Markov law; it is neither a published-method refutation nor an estimator-independent minimax converse.
statement_notes.consumer: HeartSteps II simulations obtain a fully specified adaptive stress design.

statement_notes.justification: This is conservative secondary support: scalar Freedman bounds and a union bound give direct finite-sample simultaneous coverage.
statement_notes.gap: The theorem does not validate the leave-one-cell-out covariance estimator, positivity of a random studentizer, or asymptotic exactness of a multiplier critical value.
statement_notes.consumer: Predeclared polynomial-size dense query families receive explicit radii with a visible \(\sqrt{\log|\mathcal G_n|}\) multiplicity cost.

statement_notes.justification: After the matched-rate claim is removed, the live question is first whether the minimax risk follows \(b_{nm}\), \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\), or an intermediate rate; a sharp constant is meaningful only after that exponent gap closes.
statement_notes.gap: Open obligation: construct an observed-data estimator improving the loose upper bound or prove an estimator-independent lower bound larger than \(b_{nm}\), without adding singular-factor predictability or exogeneity.  The current IPW-specific obstruction cannot decide this question.
statement_notes.consumer: A resolution would determine the attainable design-budget and signal-strength law before any sharp-constant calculation.
